says: Today's lead tooling: the two lock overlap checks in `scripts/caps.test.ts` (lines 266 and 1002) wait a fixed 250 ms or 100 ms and then look for overlap, so they pass on a broken lock when the second wrapper is slow to start.
proof: Found by the review of pull request 1286 on 2026-11-14, by reading the two checks: each starts wrapper a, then wrapper b, sleeps a fixed time with `setTimeout`, and asserts on what has been written by then. If b has not started within that time, nothing overlaps and the check passes whether or not the lock holds.
cost: On a loaded machine the checks can pass with no working lock. A fix: assert the order start a, end a, start b from the wrappers' own log, with no fixed wait.
